title: Maanasthan
desc: Deiva, a successful farmer and obedient son, is stunned when his father learns he's not his biological child. Betrayed, his father asks him to leave, leading Deiva on a journey of self-discovery.

title: Paravaigal Palavitham
desc: A group of friends in college dream of being successful. However, due to financial and employment problems, they begin to watch their dreams fade.

title: Marudhani
desc: Manikam, a teacher, comes to work in a village and stays in Marudhani's house. Later, Marudhani falls in love with him after he protects her dignity.

title: Vivaramana Aalu
desc: A robber abandons his wife for a wealthy woman, but soon regrets his decision. Later, he returns, vowing to win back her trust and prove his love.

title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.
